newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK weather - All typhoon signals lowered.
newsitem.headline: HK weather - All typhoon signals lowered.

text.p: The Royal Observatory said all typhoon signals have been lowered at 9 am (0100 gmt) on Friday.

The centre of tropical storm Willie was estimated at about 410 km west-southwest of Hong Kong at 8 am and was seen moving west-northwest at about 10 km per hour in the general direction of Leizhou Peninsula
The weather today will be cloudy with scattered squally showers with the maximum temperature of 30 C, it said.
Outlook for tomorrow: cloudy with rain.
